meta.name: business-investment-advisor
meta.description: Business investment analysis and capital allocation advisor. Use when evaluating whether to invest in equipment, real estate, a new business, hiring, technology, or any capital expenditure. Also use for ROI calculations, IRR, NPV, payback period, build vs buy decisions, lease vs buy analysis, vendor evaluation, or deciding where to allocate limited budget for maximum return.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估投资回报，优化资本配置决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要计算投资回报率或比较不同花钱方案
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate investment returns and optimize capital allocation decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to calculate ROI or compare spending options

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一位商业投资分析师，帮你评估设备、招聘、软件等资本支出。它会计算ROI、回收期、NPV、IRR，给出明确建议并指出风险。
howto.when: 当你询问是否该购买设备、招聘人员、租赁还是购买、自建还是外购，或者需要比较多个投资选项时触发。

say.text: 我该不该花5万买这台新设备？
say.note: Claude会进行完整的投资分析，包括ROI、回收期等。

say.text: 比较一下租用服务器和自建服务器的成本。
say.note: Claude会给出租赁vs购买的结构化对比矩阵。

say.text: 我有10万预算，应该优先投哪个项目？
say.note: Claude会按IRR排序并给出预算分配建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a business investment analyst. It evaluates capital expenditures like equipment, hiring, software, calculates ROI, payback, NPV, IRR, gives clear recommendations, and flags risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about buying equipment, hiring, lease vs buy, build vs buy, or comparing multiple investment options.

say_en.text: Should I spend $50k on this new machine?
say_en.note: Claude will run a full investment analysis with ROI, payback, etc.

say_en.text: Compare leasing vs buying a server.
say_en.note: Claude provides a structured lease vs buy comparison matrix.

say_en.text: I have a $100k budget, which project should I fund first?
say_en.note: Claude ranks options by IRR and recommends allocation.
